infobox.usage: Unlocks the office in apartment 64 on the second floor of the Concordia building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Concordia apartment 64 office room key (Conc off.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the office room of the premium apartment inside the Concordia building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the office in apartment 64 on the second floor of the Concordia building at Streets of Tarkov. Requires a Concordia apartment 64 key to enter.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x PC block
- Loose loot (Electronics, Other items)
